$comment: Machine-readable half of docs/plans/phase0-acceptance-criteria.md. Completeness enforced by backend/tests/phase0-spec-coverage.test.js, which requires the matrix to be rectangular over the orchestrator's own STEP_CAPABILITY table. The executable suite is backend/tests/phase0-payload-parity.test.js; case ids match.

acceptance_criteria.name: Builder registration and provider dispatch
acceptance_criteria.statement: Every capability the orchestrator dispatches resolves to a registered builder, and the provider that runs is the one provider_config names.
acceptance_criteria.failure_means: A capability silently has no builder, or a project's provider choice is ignored — the two shapes the current defects take.

acceptance_criteria.name: Payload content
acceptance_criteria.statement: Every payload carries the capability's required content keys and is never the four-key {shot_id, scene_id, project_id, step} stub.
acceptance_criteria.failure_means: The generator is being asked to produce something from nothing; output is unrelated to the screenplay.

acceptance_criteria.name: Caller parity and determinism
acceptance_criteria.statement: The payload is identical whether the per-domain route or the orchestrator asks for it, and identical context yields identical payload.
acceptance_criteria.failure_means: Running a shot through the pipeline gives a different result than running it from its own page — the defect Phase 0 exists to remove.

acceptance_criteria.name: Consistency propagation
acceptance_criteria.statement: Locked seed, prompt/negative additions, and reference images reach the payload for every capability that supports them.
acceptance_criteria.failure_means: Character identity drifts between shots; the consistency system is applied on one path and dropped on the other.

acceptance_criteria.name: Cardinality and scope
acceptance_criteria.statement: One-to-many capabilities return arrays, one-to-one return a single object, and scene-scoped capabilities build with no shot present.
acceptance_criteria.failure_means: Dialogue lines or SFX cues are silently collapsed to one, or a scene-level cue demands a shot it should not need.

acceptance_criteria.name: Error paths and preconditions
acceptance_criteria.statement: Missing preconditions raise a diagnosable error; genuinely empty inputs yield zero payloads rather than one malformed payload.
acceptance_criteria.failure_means: Undefined URLs and empty prompts reach the provider, burning budget on a request that could never succeed.

capabilities.notes: Also the site of defect 2: routes/storyboard.js:97 calls fetch(GRIDLIGHT_URL + '/image') with no provider resolution.

cases.scenario: The registry is asked for the image builder.
cases.expected: A function is registered, and generation resolves through resolve('image', provider_config).
cases.failure_means: Storyboards keep going to Gridlight regardless of the project's configured image provider.

cases.scenario: A fully populated shot with characters, location and style preset.
cases.expected: payload.prompt and payload.negative_prompt are non-empty strings; key set is not the four-key stub.
cases.failure_means: The orchestrator is generating keyframes from an empty prompt.

cases.scenario: Compare the builder's prompt against buildStoryboardPrompt called directly with the same context.
cases.expected: prompt and negative_prompt are strictly equal.
cases.failure_means: The extraction changed prompt semantics; every existing storyboard becomes irreproducible.

cases.scenario: Context carries a locked seed, prompt additions and a face reference.
cases.expected: The serialized payload contains the seed, the addition, or the reference.
cases.failure_means: Faces drift across shots on the orchestrated path while holding on the route path.

cases.scenario: One shot is built.
cases.expected: A single payload object, not an array.
cases.failure_means: Callers must branch on shape, and the job-row INSERT writes an array into a scalar column.

cases.scenario: An empty context object is passed.
cases.expected: Throws an Error with a message longer than a bare type error.
cases.failure_means: undefined propagates to the provider and fails far from its cause.

preconditions: keyframe asset optional — supplies init_image when present

cases.scenario: The registry is asked for the video builder.
cases.expected: A function is registered; generation resolves through resolve('video', provider_config), so a Runway-configured project reaches Runway.
cases.failure_means: Per-project provider selection is decorative for video.

cases.scenario: A shot with camera movement and lighting in its scene card.
cases.expected: All eight required keys present; camera_control is an object, not a string.
cases.failure_means: film_video_jobs rows are written with null model/fps/frames and the render ledger cannot reproduce the clip.

cases.scenario: Compare against buildVideoPayload called directly with the same context.
cases.expected: prompt equal; camera_control.type equal.
cases.failure_means: Orchestrated video differs from route-generated video for the same shot.

cases.scenario: Context carries reference images and input_refs.
cases.expected: Payload carries the seed, references or input_refs.
cases.failure_means: The character in the video is not the character in the keyframe.

cases.scenario: One shot is built.
cases.expected: A single payload object.
cases.failure_means: Shape branching leaks into every caller.

cases.scenario: An empty context object is passed.
cases.expected: Throws a diagnosable Error.
cases.failure_means: A malformed request reaches a paid video endpoint.

preconditions: scene card contains a dialogue array
capabilities.notes: The only shot-scoped capability whose cardinality is driven by scene-card content rather than by the shot itself.

cases.scenario: The registry is asked for the voice builder.
cases.expected: A function is registered; generation resolves through resolve('voice', provider_config) so an ElevenLabs project reaches ElevenLabs.
cases.failure_means: Voice provider choice silently ignored.

cases.scenario: A shot with one dialogue line and a matched voice profile.
cases.expected: Each payload carries text, model, language, emotion, output_format, sample_rate; text equals the line.
cases.failure_means: The TTS request has no text — the clearest form of the stub-payload bug.

cases.scenario: Build twice from identical context.
cases.expected: Deep-equal payload arrays.
cases.failure_means: Non-determinism makes the render ledger meaningless for dialogue.

cases.scenario: Context carries a voice consistency profile for the speaking character.
cases.expected: Payload reflects the profile (voice_id, speaker embedding, or locked params).
cases.failure_means: The same character is voiced differently shot to shot.

cases.scenario: A shot whose scene card has two dialogue lines.
cases.inputs: fixtureCtx() with a second line pushed
cases.expected: An array of exactly 2 payloads; payload[1].text is the second line.
cases.failure_means: Half the dialogue is never generated and the shot plays silent.

cases.scenario: A shot with an empty dialogue array.
cases.expected: Returns an empty array — zero payloads, no throw.
cases.failure_means: A silent shot triggers a paid TTS call for an empty string.

capabilities.builder: inline in routes/lipsync.js; extracted into capability-payloads.js by Phase 0
capabilities.notes: Currently the only orchestrated capability with no lib builder at all; routes/lipsync.js:115 assembles the literal. Flagged by global.no-inline-payloads.

cases.scenario: The registry is asked for the lipsync builder.
cases.expected: A function is registered — the inline literal has become a real builder.
cases.failure_means: Phase 0 extracted seven of eight capabilities and left the eighth inline.

cases.scenario: A shot with both a video and a dialogue audio asset.
cases.expected: video_url and audio_url resolve to the asset paths; model and quality defaulted.
cases.failure_means: The lipsync service receives undefined URLs.

cases.scenario: Build twice from identical context.
cases.expected: Deep-equal payloads.
cases.failure_means: Non-deterministic asset selection between callers.

cases.scenario: Context carries consistency data.
cases.expected: Consistency is accepted without corrupting the payload; lipsync consumes assets, not prompts, so propagation is a no-op it must tolerate.
cases.failure_means: Passing consistency context to an asset-driven capability throws.

cases.scenario: One shot is built.
cases.expected: A single payload object.
cases.failure_means: Shape mismatch against film_lipsync_jobs.

cases.scenario: The shot has no video asset, then separately no audio asset.
cases.inputs: fixtureCtx({ videoAsset: null }); fixtureCtx({ audioAsset: null })
cases.expected: Throws matching /video/i and /audio/i respectively.
cases.failure_means: The 400 the route returns today becomes a malformed provider call on the orchestrated path.

preconditions: a music cue row, or cue fields supplied as overrides

cases.scenario: The registry is asked for the music builder.
cases.expected: A function is registered; resolve('music', provider_config) governs which service runs.
cases.failure_means: Music provider choice ignored.

cases.scenario: A scene with a mood-bearing cue.
cases.expected: prompt, model, duration_s present; prompt reflects mood.
cases.failure_means: film_music_jobs stores a null prompt and duration.

cases.scenario: Build twice from identical context.
cases.expected: Deep-equal payloads.
cases.failure_means: Cue selection differs between callers for the same scene.

cases.scenario: Context carries consistency data.
cases.expected: Tolerated without corrupting the payload; music has no visual identity to lock.
cases.failure_means: Uniform context handling is not actually uniform.

cases.scenario: Build with the shot deleted from context.
cases.inputs: fixtureCtx() with shot and sceneCard removed
cases.expected: A single payload with a prompt — scene context alone suffices.
cases.failure_means: A scene-scoped cue cannot be generated without picking an arbitrary shot.

cases.scenario: An empty context object is passed.
cases.expected: Throws a diagnosable Error.
cases.failure_means: A scene-less music request reaches the provider.

preconditions: scene card contains an sfx_cues array

cases.scenario: The registry is asked for the sfx builder.
cases.expected: A function is registered; resolve('sfx', provider_config) governs the service.
cases.failure_means: SFX provider choice ignored.

cases.scenario: A shot whose scene card declares one cue.
cases.expected: One payload with type, prompt, duration_s, model, category.
cases.failure_means: Cues are requested with no description.

cases.scenario: Build twice from identical context.
cases.expected: Deep-equal payload arrays.
cases.failure_means: Cue ordering is unstable, so takes cannot be matched to cues.

cases.scenario: Context carries consistency data.
cases.expected: Tolerated without corrupting the payloads.
cases.failure_means: Uniform context handling is not uniform.

cases.scenario: A shot with cues present.
cases.expected: An array, one payload per cue.
cases.failure_means: Multiple cues collapse into one sound.

cases.scenario: A scene card with no sfx_cues key.
cases.expected: Returns an empty array — no throw, no payload.
cases.failure_means: Every silent shot triggers a paid SFX generation.

capabilities.notes: Ambient is a loop, not a full render. duration_s is the loop; bed_duration_s is what it must cover. Losing that split is a silent regression the mixer cannot detect.

cases.scenario: The registry is asked for the ambient builder.
cases.expected: A function is registered; resolve('ambient', provider_config) governs the service.
cases.failure_means: Ambient provider choice ignored.

cases.scenario: A 45-second night interior scene.
cases.expected: All six required keys; prompt reflects location and time of day.
cases.failure_means: The bed is generated with no description of the space.

cases.scenario: Inspect the loop/bed split for a 45s scene.
cases.expected: duration_s <= 30 (a loop), bed_duration_s === 45, loopable === true.
cases.failure_means: The mixer plays the bed once and leaves the rest of the scene dry — the exact regression the loop design was added to prevent.

cases.scenario: Context carries consistency data.
cases.expected: Tolerated without corrupting the payload.
cases.failure_means: Uniform context handling is not uniform.

cases.scenario: Build with the shot deleted from context.
cases.inputs: fixtureCtx() with shot and sceneCard removed
cases.expected: A single payload with a prompt.
cases.failure_means: A scene-level bed needs a shot it should not need.

cases.scenario: An empty context object is passed.
cases.expected: Throws a diagnosable Error.
cases.failure_means: A bed is requested for no scene, with a default duration nobody chose.

capabilities.builder: inline buildPostPayload in routes/post-production.js; extracted into capability-payloads.js by Phase 0
capabilities.notes: The one capability with sub-types: upscale, face_restore, color_grade, composite. The orchestrator's single 'post' step must select one, and that selection is currently unspecified.

cases.scenario: The registry is asked for the post builder.
cases.expected: A function is registered and accepts a job-type override; resolve('post', provider_config) governs the service.
cases.failure_means: The four post sub-types remain reachable only from the route.

cases.scenario: A shot with a rendered video asset.
cases.expected: input_url resolves to the video asset path; output_format present.
cases.failure_means: The post service is handed an undefined input URL.

cases.scenario: Build twice from identical context.
cases.expected: Deep-equal payloads, including the default job type.
cases.failure_means: The orchestrated post step does something different each run.

cases.scenario: Context carries consistency data.
cases.expected: Tolerated without corrupting the payload.
cases.failure_means: Uniform context handling is not uniform.

cases.scenario: One shot is built.
cases.expected: A single payload object.
cases.failure_means: Shape mismatch against film_post_jobs.

cases.scenario: The shot has no source video.
cases.expected: Throws matching /video/i.
cases.failure_means: Post-production runs against nothing and reports success.

global_cases.scenario: Static inspection of routes/pipeline.js after Phase 0.
global_cases.expected: No `const payload = { shot_id...` literal remains, and buildCapabilityPayload is referenced.
global_cases.failure_means: Defect 1 is still live: every orchestrated generation is made from four ids and no prompt.

global_cases.scenario: Static inspection of routes/storyboard.js after Phase 0.
global_cases.expected: No fetch(`${GRIDLIGHT_URL}/image`) remains, and resolve('image', ...) is used.
global_cases.failure_means: Defect 2 is still live: provider_config.image is ignored on the most visible path in the product.

global_cases.scenario: Scan every route that calls a provider for a payload literal containing a `stream:` key.
global_cases.inputs: All of backend/routes/*.js that reference resolveGenerator or .generate(
global_cases.expected: No offenders. Known offender at spec time: lipsync.js.
global_cases.failure_means: A second construction path survives, so parity between orchestrator and route is coincidental rather than structural.
